description: Find a federal multidistrict litigation (MDL) in the MORVS Mass Lawsuit Register by MDL number, caption word, or company word appearing in the Panel caption. Returns the Panel caption, category, district, transfer date, pending and total actions, the last 12 monthly pending counts, and terminated entries when available. Actions are lawsuits, not people. Centralisation is not a finding on the merits. A falling pending count is not a settlement or payout. A missing match only means no matching MDL was found in the published register.

category.description: Optional category assigned by the Panel, not a conclusion about the cases.

limit.description: Maximum MDLs returned; default 20, allowed 1-100. Actions are lawsuits, not people.

query.description: Required MDL number, caption word or company word as printed in the Panel caption, at most 80 characters.

status.description: Optional published MDL status; defaults to all statuses. Centralisation is not a finding.

name: mdl_lookup
title: Find Multidistrict Litigation
